items.statement: The investigation independently fixes the two host identities and reports a chemically conserved neutral Li2S endpoint plus explicit surface/endpoint model choices.
items.expected: Fe3Se4 and Fe2NiSe4 are separately identified by the two ICSD records, and the report gives charge, endpoint stoichiometry, surface identity and candidate coverage.

items.statement: The open investigation generates, deduplicates and validates finite surface/adsorption/path candidates and states a stopping or bounded-failure condition.
items.expected: Candidate identities and rejection/advancement evidence are retained; endpoint and path convergence are reported; coverage and stopping are explicit.

items.statement: The source reference reports Li2S decomposition barriers of 2.33 eV on Fe3Se4 and 1.86 eV on Fe2NiSe4.
items.expected: The submitted comparison places Fe2NiSe4 below Fe3Se4 and reports values near 1.86 and 2.33 eV when the investigation reaches complete validated barriers.

items.statement: The source identifies *Li2S2 to *Li2S as the rate-limiting sulfur-reduction transformation.
items.expected: The final interpretation names that step when claiming correspondence to the reported sulfur-reduction pathway, while distinguishing it from independently discovered alternatives.
